There are 44 participating teams.{{cite web|url=https://img.legaseriea.it/vimages/6654a871/253%20-%20Regolamento%20Coppa%20Italia%20Frecciarossa%202024-2027.pdf|title=Coppa Italia: Regolamento|publisher=Lega Serie A|language=it|access-date=19 August 2025|date=27 May 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250903230346/https://img.legaseriea.it/vimages/6654a871/253%20-%20Regolamento%20Coppa%20Italia%20Frecciarossa%202024-2027.pdf|archive-date=3 September 2025|url-status=dead}} [[Inter Milan]] are the defending champions, having won their tenth title in the [[2025–26 Coppa Italia|previous edition]] after defeating [[SS Lazio|Lazio]] 2–0 in the [[2026 Coppa Italia final|final]]. ==Format and seeding== Teams entered the competition at various stages, as follows: * '''First phase''' (one-legged fixtures) ** Preliminary round: the four teams from [[Serie C]] and four [[Serie B]] teams started the tournament ** First round: the four winners were joined by the remaining 16 [[Serie B]] teams, and 12 teams from [[Serie A]] ** Second round: the 16 winners faced each other * '''Second phase''' ** Round of 16 (one-legged): the eight winners were joined by [[Serie A]] clubs, seeded 1–8 (last year winners [[Inter Milan]] and clubs ranked 2–8 in the [[2025–26 Serie A]]) ** Quarter-finals (one-legged): the eight winners face each other ** Semi-finals (two-legged): the four winners face each other ** Final (one-legged): the two winners face each other ==Round dates== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center; font-size: 100%; width: 800px;" !
